edge_thesis: Short-horizon mean reversion in broad index ETFs after a mild intraday pullback within an established uptrend. Liquidity providers and market makers absorb forced selling from stop-driven and index-rebalancing flows, and they are often net sellers into strength. On the other side are short-term momentum sellers and risk-reducing institutions who sell into weakness. The edge is small and depends on tight stops to keep the drawdown-to-R ratio favorable.

picks.why: Uptrend pullback in the broad US equity index; a reward of about 1.2R to a stop below recent swing lows.
Long-duration Treasuries as a hedge against an equity drawdown; the stop sits under the recent range.
